miel.copy: Copy Button owns clipboard affordance, naming, and feedback across Flow.
canDecide: Use Copy Button when a single known value should be copied.
Use icon variant only with a clear accessible name.
Use inline variant inside metadata rows or code block headers.
mustAsk: The copied value is dynamic, private, destructive, or unclear.
The failure state has no recovery action.
The copy target competes with another primary action.
rejectIf: The control is a local span, div, or fake button.
The label does not identify the copied target when several copy controls are visible.
miel.handoff: Name the copy target and preserve error recovery before adding a copy action.
